title: Add MailBackend::find_thread_by_message_ids trait method
description: Add to backend.rs: fn find_thread_by_message_ids(&self, account_id: &Id, message_ids: &[&str]) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Option<Id>, Self::Error>> + Send; Returns the thread_id of the first stored Email whose message_id list intersects message_ids, or None if no match. Breaking change to MailBackend — all implementors must add this method.
